title: Toward a Science of AI Agent Societies
abstract: arXiv:2611.25404v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents are rapidly evolving from isolated personal assistants into networked actors that interact with one another at scale. We envision the emergence of AI agent societies, with their own social and economic dynamics, as a new research frontier. We argue that AI agent societies should be studied as a distinct object of inquiry: neither simply larger collections of individual agents nor merely simulations of human society. To formalize this perspective, we propose four core properties that a valid AI agent society should satisfy: individualized objectives, rules and governance, autonomy, and scale and complexity. Building on this framework, we identify four classes of societal behaviors worth studying in AI agent societies: economic behaviors, behaviors under conflict-of-interest, unsafe and unethical behaviors, and system-level behaviors. translated_title: 迈向AI智能体社会的科学
translated_abstract: AI智能体正迅速从孤立的个人助手演变为大规模相互作用的网络化行为主体。我们展望AI智能体社会的兴起——它们拥有自身的社会和经济动态——并将其视为一个新的研究前沿。我们主张，AI智能体社会应作为一个独特的研究对象加以研究：它既不是个体智能体的简单放大集合，也不仅仅是人类社会的模拟。为将这一观点形式化，我们提出了一个有效的AI智能体社会应满足的四个核心属性：个性化目标、规则与治理、自主性，以及规模与复杂性。基于这一框架，我们识别出AI智能体社会中值得研究的四类社会行为：经济行为、利益冲突下的行为、不安全和不道德的行为，以及系统级行为。随后，我们概述了关键技术挑战——包括属性参数化、参数平衡等（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文主张将AI智能体社会作为一个独立的研究对象，提出其应满足个性化目标、规则与治理、自主性、规模与复杂性四个核心属性，并识别出四类值得研究的社会行为及相应的关键技术挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper advocates studying AI agent societies as a distinct object of inquiry, proposing four core properties (individualized objectives, rules and governance, autonomy, and scale and complexity) and identifying four classes of societal behaviors worth studying along with key technical challenges.
